retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist 1970s-style layout featuring a large, heavy display title with a vertical sunset gradient against a dark, textured background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition dominated by a large, stylized wordmark in the upper third. The text features a warm yellow-to-red vertical gradient and sits on a deep purple-black field characterized by circular ring-wear and fine dust textures typical of vintage vinyl records.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm vibrant text against a cool dark void
Sharp geometric letterforms against organic circular distress
Top-heavy weight distribution for immediate impact
coreInvariants: Vertical linear gradient within the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text is centered horizontally and positioned in the upper 30% of the frame, scaled to span nearly the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text and moves downward into the dark space, following the subtle circular texture of the ring-wear.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the bottom two-thirds creates a sense of depth and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White/grey for texture and distress marks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text contrasting with near-zero value in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, high-contrast display script with flared terminals and sharp angles.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Sharp, pointed terminals on ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'j' with a long, sharp descender
Uppercase 'B' with a stylized, flat-top flourish
Lowercase 'k' with a sharp, angular kick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display type; if secondary text is needed, use a small, clean sans-serif in the corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy weight and 70s geometric feel
Captures the flared terminals and retro display vibe

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep purple-black solid background with a subtle, large circular 'ring-wear' texture and fine white dust speckles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, heavy display wordmark in the upper third using a vertical linear gradient from bright yellow at the top to deep red at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the text gradient strictly vertical?
Is the background dark enough to make the text pop?
Is the ring-wear texture visible but subtle?
Are the letterforms heavy and sharp?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top left corner
Exact letterform of the 'j' descender to avoid direct copy
postGenerationChecks: Ensure texture does not obscure the text legibility
Confirm the '70s funk' mood is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Heavy display type + vertical sunset gradient + dark textured negative space = 70s Retro Funk Aesthetic.
